notes.name: feedback
notes.note:
this clip does not go all the way to the end and when i tried to expand it i realized it was because you made the twitter graphics for the reels (and the tv frames) into videos of the length needed instead of treating them as the graphic overlays they actually are which would allow them to be used for whatever duration needed because it would just be an image. this would be different if it was an actual animation but they are simply an overlay graphics, and by implementing them as videos you waste time rendering videos and hardcoding lengths on soemthing that does not require it because they are stills and not animations

what im pointing out here is not only a fix that needs to be implemented for all 31 reels here but is a more generalized fix that is needed for Ren
